notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello castaways! As announced early this week on our discord and Playtest version, we are now nearing our Early Access release! You can expect an announcement of our Early Access release date within a week.

If you haven't gotten access to the Playtest (beta testing) yet, you can still request it via our Steam store page. Thanks for everyone who has signed up so far and have been providing feedback.

Don't forget to wishlist us!

Our released Early Access will contain:

[olist]
[*] Crafting of 30+ different tools and weapons.
[*] Building of 50+ different structures, utility and modular houses.
[*] Procedural islands: Each gameplay is unique.
[*] Resource gathering: Pick, forage and chop vegetation.
[*] Vitals: Balance your hunger, thirst, temperature, sanity, vitamins and proteins and energy to survive.
[*] Weather: Rain and foggy cycles.
[*] Day and night cycles.
[*] Custom-made modular rafts.
[*] Hunting: Spear and rod fishing and different traps for water, land and air animals.
[*] 4 quests and one mini-quest.
[*] Scavenging: Break down found junk.
[*] Cooking, brewing and seasoning.
[*] Exploring: Each island pose a different strategy, with unique key elements.
[*] Underwater: Ruins, wrecks, resources and beautiful scenery.
[*] Farming; Grow your own resources.
[*] Mining: Gather and smelt ores for equipment.
[*] Blueprints for complex structures.
[*] Easter eggs.
[*] Full controller support and custom keybinds.
[*] Localization of 14 languages.
[/olist]

After our first retail patch, we will be working towards console support and co-op.

Check out our latest Playtest[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2836940/view/6521861444661921147] patch notes[/url].

See you in a near future,
The project castaway team

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello castaways. A new update [b]0.0.31[/b] is available for our [b]Playtest [/b]version. This update brings in new weapons and tool tiers, available through mining. We are also starting with an UI overhaul, which will open doors for localization for the next patch.

If you do not yet have access to the game, you can simply request access to the playtest via our steam store page. We roll out access at random every update. We are hoping to officially announce our early access launch date pretty soon, as we begin to deploy major quality of life changes.

Are you a playtester? Read the full patch notes here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2836940/view/4243035499690723921?l=english

Not a playtester yet? Enjoy a playthrough from Jae Jachl. :-)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0gz6mTkNFIE&t=2924

Happy surviving,
The project castaway team

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
[b]Project Castaway 0.0.27[/b] is now up. Focusing on commonly requested visual toggles.

Full changelog can be found here [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2836940/view/4181104663302830138]here[/url]

Our next patch is going to receive a massive content overhaul: New procedural islands, new items to craft, new animals and traps, and much more!

If you haven't already - hit the wishlist button and request playtest access. We are still slowly rolling out access. The feedback given on our form, steam and discord has been extremely helpful, so thank you and keep them coming!

Happy surviving.

notes.title: Development Update 🎉
notes.notes:
First of all, I want to thank everyone who provided feedback via steam, discord and our in-game form. We have taken the most reported issues and suggestions and implemented them. Keep them coming! ❤️

Our playtest is never closed and we are constantly accepting people. So if you haven't requested, hit the button on our store page and don't forget to wishlist us!

We have just patched our version [b]0.0.26[/b], with quite a few new systems. Full changelog can be found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2836940/view/4193488293627557781]here[/url].

We are planning to officially announce our release date as well as our roadmap for release and post-release soon.

Have fun surviving!
- Dark

notes.title: Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

We've been hard at work to give you the best survival experience possible. We have not been that public in terms of development. We've had a private group within our discord that has helped us iterate and play weekly builds. If you had ever at all been interested in testing more opportunities are coming in the future. 


Some key updates that I want to state. We have an endgame and a treasure hunt task. We have 24 randomly placed treasures + Clues within the world for you to discover. 


The game is unforgiving. No difficulty settings will be available at launch and it will be one life 1 death. In the future, we explore adding more options. 

We've also made the decision to remove multiplayer to fully give singleplayer our complete focus. Multiplayer Co Op will come within 2 months post-launch, for those who cannot wait. 

We've also decided on a price which will be $9.99 USD.  As we add more features and multiplayer plus eventually mod support we will raise the price over time to reflect the new quality level. 

There's a lot more in store but you'll just have to bear with us a bit longer. Our best estimate is a release date in September at this point. 

Also we need a brand new trailer LOL. The current one is really really old

[url=https://streamable.com/tqcpm1]Small teaser[/url]
